summary: Practise client service recovery, renewal reviews and value-led growth planning. Explore this five-day client management training course.
lede: Client management helps client-facing professionals coordinate service commitments, maintain relationship records and prepare renewal and growth discussions. For client service, account and customer success roles, this foundation-level course develops practical skills in expectation-setting, complaint handling and reviewing client value. You will use CRM records and Excel scorecards to map ownership, interpret client feedback, track renewal risks and prepare client reviews; advanced analytics and CRM automation receive introductory coverage.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage ongoing client relationships, coordinate service delivery or support account continuity. It suits people who need practical methods for recording commitments, responding to service problems and preparing clear client review discussions.
modules: Client Outcome Reviews and Value Evidence
Renewal Readiness and Client Risk Signals
Client Account Plan and Review Pack
prerequisites: Basic workplace experience handling client requests, service interactions or account administration is useful. No coding is required; Excel access is needed for the workbook exercises.
